suspects.opportunity: access to the library after hours
suspects.alibi: claimed to be in the kitchen preparing dinner
attended a private reading session in the garden

suspects.motive: covering up the Baron’s gambling debts

roomNarratives.summary: A quiet space where staff gathered. The torn page of a ledger was found near the well.
The table was set for a late meal, but the cook’s knife was missing.
A private reading session was interrupted by a sudden disturbance. A bookmark lay torn.
The victim’s bloodstained gloves were found near the fireplace. A candle was extinguished.
The cook’s apron bore a faint stain. A note was found in the pantry: *

clueAssignments.hint: A torn bookmark suggests recent activity in the study.

npcDialogOverrides.default: I was in the kitchen—*clears throat*—I was preparing dinner.

conditions.dialog: You found the torn page? That’s odd. The study was locked. I’d never—

npcDialogOverrides.default: I was cleaning the kitchen. Why would anyone need the library at this hour?

conditions.dialog: The study? I was there—*hesitates*—but I didn’t touch anything. The Baroness would never—

npcDialogOverrides.default: We were monitoring the garden. The study was secure.

conditions.dialog: The study? We checked. The bookmark was found in the garden—*pauses*—unusual placement.
